description: This file defines the Views class in the Drupal framework, providing static methods for managing views, plugins, and related services within the Drupal views module.

classes.name: Views
classes.description: A static wrapper class providing access to Drupal views services, plugin management, and view entities.

methods.name: viewsData
methods.description: Returns the views data service object.

methods.name: viewsDataHelper
methods.description: Returns the views data helper service object.

methods.name: executableFactory
methods.description: Returns the views executable factory service.

methods.name: pluginManager
methods.description: Deprecated method to get plugin manager for a specific view plugin type.

methods.name: handlerManager
methods.description: Deprecated method to get handler manager for a specific view handler type.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Loads a view entity by ID and returns its executable object.

methods.name: fetchPluginNames
methods.description: Fetches plugin names for a given type, optionally filtered by display types and base tables.

methods.name: getPluginDefinitions
methods.description: Returns definitions for all view plugin types.

methods.name: getEnabledDisplayExtenders
methods.description: Returns enabled display extenders from configuration.

methods.name: getApplicableViews
methods.description: Returns view and display IDs that have a specific display plugin setting.

methods.name: getViewsAsOptions
methods.description: Returns views as options array for form elements, with filtering and sorting options.

methods.name: pluginList
methods.description: Provides a list of plugins and metadata about them, including views using each plugin.

methods.name: getHandlerTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of view handler types with descriptive labels.

methods.name: getPluginTypes
methods.description: Returns list of plugin types, filtered by 'plugin' or 'handler'.

methods.name: t
methods.description: Translates a string to the current language, with optional arguments.
